fact_text: On the PSX a stock's upper cap and lower lock sit 10% above and below its opening rate, so trades for the day stay inside that band.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: When heavy buy or sell orders pile up at a cap or lock, trading at that limit is paused for a limited time until the pressure on that side eases.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: The PSX had 561 listed companies grouped into 38 sectors as of 19 Aug 2026, according to the broker's platform tutorial.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: PSX futures are monthly contracts; open positions settle on the final Friday of each contract month, so a position not closed by then converts to a regular-market holding.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: PSX futures orders have a minimum lot of 500 shares and must be placed in multiples of 500, such as 500, 1,000 or 1,500 shares.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: Futures buying or short-selling power is sized as a multiple of a client's free cash balance, so free cash caps the size of a futures position.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: As of 19 Aug 2026 the PSX accepted three order types, limit, stop-loss and market; fill-or-kill and must-in-the-market (MIT) orders were no longer working.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: A stop-loss buy order is conditional: it activates only when the price reaches the stop price, and then fills only if the stock trades within the limit range set above it.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: A market order fills at whatever prices resting offers exist, so a large order can execute in pieces at several prices and is reported at one average execution price.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: PSX orders are routed by market segment: regular (REG), futures (FUT), leverage (LB, for margin-financed trades) and cash-settled futures (CSF).
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: The market depth view stacks buy bids and sell offers by volume and by price, showing where average buyers and sellers sit before a trader places an order.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: Unsettled profit or loss on a holding is the gap between the average buy price and the current market price; it becomes settled only when the shares are sold.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: The broker's TradeCast desktop platform lets a client request a time-limited loan limit when a bank transfer to the account is delayed, after which the broker assigns the limit.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)

fact_text: PSX daily price limits are set from a stock's opening price: the upper cap is 10% above and the lower lock is 10% below, so a stock opening at 100 trades between 90 and 110.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, 'TradeCast Complete Tutorial | SCS Trade Desktop Trading Platform | Orders, Portfolio & Market Watch' (YouTube, 2026-08-19)
